chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Exception
text: 2.25 Exception When an Authorisation is lost by a Government agency and a proof to this effect is submitted, documents at serial nos. (i) to (iii) of Paragraph 2.24 above shall not be required. In such cases, revalidation shall be for six months from date of endorsement.
intent: Support Exception processing and compliance validation.
